chapters.title: DGBN Workflow Sample - Chapter 1: Robben Island
chapters.headline: The island that held Mandela.

scenes.text: Robben Island lies off the coast near Cape Town. For three decades it held South Africa's political prisoners, Nelson Mandela among them.
Mandela spent eighteen of his twenty-seven years in prison there.

chapters.title: DGBN Workflow Sample - Chapter 2: The Museum
chapters.headline: From prison to museum.

scenes.text: Today the island is a museum. In 1999 it became a World Heritage Site.

visuals.sub: Robben Island becomes a World Heritage Site
